thread:
maria-sec: FYI — we just received a DSAR (ID DSAR-2026-042) requesting deletion of user data that may be present in cold backups and S3 Glacier archives. Need input on two paths: (1) retention exception for backups >90 days, (2) RBAC change to allow a limited "erasure-operator" role to run scrub jobs. Any blockers?

ajay-crypto: Quick q: are those backups encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key or our platform key? If customer CMK we can't decrypt without key owner consent. If platform CMK we can rotate/revoke but need to coordinate with KMS team.

lisa-legal: We need the DSAR intake doc + explicit scope. If backups contain PII, legal prefers a targeted deletion plan and a signed attestation. Retention exception must include justification, list of artifacts, and TTL. I'll prepare the form.

noah-devex: Technically we can do targeted deletes for DB rows and KV entries. Logs are trickier — app logs in Loki can be redacted but immutable S3 archive objects are effectively write-once. Proposed flow: 1) freeze writes for affected user id, 2) run DB/KV deletion job, 3) re-encrypt/retire affected backup blobs OR request a retention exception. Avoid full KMS key deletion unless legally required.

samir-sre: I ran an audit query for user_id=usr_94321, results below.
```
redwood-audit query --subject usr_94321 --since 2025-01-01
# results: 14 events: login, api.generate, backup.write(ark-2025-07-12), backup.write(ark-2026-01-05)
```
Backup objects found: s3://redwood-backups/ark-2025-07-12.tar.gz (encrypted: CMK_PLATFORM pm-key-77f), s3://redwood-backups/ark-2026-01-05.tar.gz (encrypted: CMK_CUSTOMER cust-key-abc).
If we proceed, we can scrub CMK_PLATFORM blobs by re-encrypting with a null/retire workflow and removing indexes. For CMK_CUSTOMER we must get the key owner to re-encrypt or authorize deletion.

maria-sec: Thanks. Action items: Ajay to confirm exact KMS owners + key IDs, Noah to draft runbook for scrub + canary checks, Lisa to confirm legal attestation wording and retention-exception rationale, Samir to open an audit ticket with object list and retention-age justification. Also need RBAC for erasure-operator — proposal: allow role to run `data-scrub` job with `--dry-run` then `--apply` gated by 2FA.

ajay-crypto: Key IDs: cust-key-abc is in customer account k-0b1c2d; platform key is pm-key-77f. Cust key requires owner approval; I'll open a cross-account request (ETA 48–72h).

lisa-legal: For DSAR responses we must confirm whether deletion will be 'complete and irreversible' or whether a retention exception applies. If we file an exception, include artifact list, legal reason (cannot decrypt cust CMK), mitigations (notify data subject), and SLA for follow-ups.

noah-devex: Draft runbook (high level + rollback):
1) create canary user and run `data-scrub --subject usr_test --dry-run`
2) verify no regressions in API and metrics for 48h
3) run `data-scrub --subject usr_94321 --apply --audit-note DSAR-2026-042`
4) push audit log entry and link scrub ticket
I'll open a PR to infra/scrub-runbooks with exact commands and alerts.

dsar-bot: DSAR-2026-042 status: acknowledged by security. Legal and SRE assigned. ETA: 3 business days for initial scope; 5–10 days if customer KMS approval required.

samir-sre: :thumbsup: I'll file retention-exception ticket in Jira (SEC-9083) and attach object list + age histogram.

maria-sec: Interim mitigation — can we mask the user id in analytics pipelines and disable automated exports so we avoid fresh copies into backups?

ajay-crypto: We can add a transform in the backup pipeline to drop `user_id` for future runs. We'll gate behind feature flag `drop-usrid-dsar` and coordinate with prod-safety.

noah-devex: I'll own the feature flag rollout and add telemetry that confirms objects created after rollout have masked ids. Will also add canary checks that flag any unmasked artifact.

lisa-legal: I'll review the retention-exception template and sign off once the ticket includes object list + mitigation. Also drafting DSAR response copy for the user.

maria-sec: Great. Reconvene on this thread in 24h for updates. Thanks everyone.
